name: Presentation starter
summary: A neutral presentation template with dark and light variants.
description: The starter template is one shell in two variants and three recipes: a generic briefing, a quarterly review, and a competitor brief. It carries no logo and no company name. It also declares four deck tools an agent can call without a model endpoint: outline, create, inspect, render.
highlights: Dark and light are two variants of one template.
Three recipes: briefing, quarterly review, competitor brief.
No logo and no company colours.

tools.name: presentation_outline
tools.description: Turn a one-line brief into a deck outline using this template's recipes.

tools.name: presentation_create
tools.description: Write a valid .pptx from an outline, or from a brief, using this template.

tools.name: presentation_inspect
tools.description: Read a deck back as slide text, notes, and package problems.

tools.name: presentation_render
tools.description: Make a PDF and slide images when PowerPoint or LibreOffice is installed.
